description: How a Reddit-fueled short squeeze (Jan 2021) blasted failing chains into the billions — then left winners, losers and one retailer bankrupt. Market-cap timeline for GameStop, AMC, BlackBerry and Bed Bath & Beyond (2019–2026 Q1).
youtube_description: From message boards to market madness: this chart-race takes you quarter-by-quarter through the Jan 2021 short squeezes that turned struggling chains and tech names into multibillion-dollar stories — and then the aftermath. GameStop and AMC exploded as retail traders coordinated on Reddit’s r/WallStreetBets, BlackBerry rode the meme-wave, and Bed Bath & Beyond ultimately filed for bankruptcy (delisted in 2023). Data: quarter-end market-cap snapshots (billions USD). Sources: company filings, exchange market caps and historical price snapshots (public market records).
